class MemoryFile:
    def __init__(self,name,state,rows): self.name,self.state,self.rows=name,state,rows
    def exists(self): return True
    def read_bytes(self): return json.dumps(self.state).encode() if self.name=='run.json' else b''.join(json.dumps(r).encode()+b'\\n' for r in self.rows)
class MemoryDirectory:
    def __init__(self,state,rows): self.state,self.rows=state,rows
    def __truediv__(self,name): return MemoryFile(name,self.state,self.rows)
def check(state,rows,schedule,reject=False,pipeline=True):
    global checks
    try: result=reconcile(MemoryDirectory(state,rows),schedule)
    except ValueError:
        assert reject
    else:
        assert not reject

    rr=deepcopy(rows); rr[0]['model_call_started']=1

    rr=deepcopy(rows); rr[0].update(status='error',model_call_started=False)

        ss=dict(state); ss.pop('model_calls_started')
        check(ss,rr,schedule)
